discovered_by: Independent combined-paper reviewer, followed by root primary-text verification
paper: Menotti, Najman, de Albuquerque Araujo. 1D Component Tree in Linear Time and Space and Its Application to Gray-Level Image Multithresholding. ISMM 2007, pp.437-448.
inspected: Sections 3.1-3.3, Algorithm1 and application description, retrieved through web text. HAL/inpe full text unavailable through web tool.
finding: 1D component-tree construction is directly relevant prior art. Its presented array for integer weight counts has O(m) space; complete space O(max(n,m)). No new component-tree construction or universal sorting lower bound is claimed. Candidate contribution is specific label-conditioned overlap and fragmentation aggregate maintenance; global uniqueness is not established by this comparison.
manuscript_changes: Direct menotti2007 citation in range method and related work
Distinguish construction cost from queried metric-aggregate maintenance

attribute_addendum.finding: Height, surface/cardinality and volume can be computed during component-tree construction without changing its time complexity. Generic component attribute maintenance is prior work. The candidate claim remains the label-conditioned Tatbul overlap and fragmentation aggregate.
